title: Asymmetric Massive Natural Rock Bridge
description: One original whole natural rock-bridge formation with a heavy uneven fractured crest, two unequal broad grounded buttresses and one genuinely open low wide underpass through its entire depth. The irregular front and rear outlines differ; intermediate depth facets create a continuous substantial stone mass rather than stacked rocks, a thin table ledge or a regular manufactured arch. One connected closed editable mesh and three coherent matte opaque stone PBR roles. All numeric geometry is newly authored; no existing outcrop, escarpment, failed mudbank or mine arch is recoloured, resized, cut apart or imported. One reusable static terrain prop, zero scenes; two rock feet and repeated facets are not separate assets. Metres, native Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. No natural-formation scientific reconstruction, erosion simulation, walking/collision/navigation, stability, load, engineering or safe traversal claim. No plants, water, text, textures or animated effects.
